evidence: createApp registers Express routes (app.post/app.get/app.patch); each handler only extracts request data and calls service.createUser/createProject/createTask/listTasks/markDone, which is transport work.
bodyOf and stringField only check types on the raw request input. They contain no business validation.
statusCode(error) maps DomainError.code values to HTTP 404/409/400, which is transport work.
The error-handling middleware turns DomainError into JSON responses and sends 500 for anything else, which is framework/transport work.
The default parameter `new TaskService(new InMemoryTaskRepository())` is composition wiring, which is fine in infrastructure.
